findings.claim: Q1 2026 revenue guidance $2.59B–$2.63B was above ~$2.54B consensus; FY2026 guided at least low double-digit revenue growth (Feb 2026 report).

findings.claim: Q3 2026 (reported 2026-11-05): revenue $4.87B up 18.9% vs $4.75B consensus; Q4 guide revenue $3.22B–$3.28B (16–18% growth); FY2026 revenue growth outlook raised to high teens.
findings.source: 247wallst Airbnb Q3 2026: Bookings Surge 16%, Full-Year Outlook Raised
findings.excerpt: Gross Booking Value jumped 21% to $27.70 billion, and that broad momentum prompted management to lift the full-year 2026 revenue growth outlook to the high teens. Revenue came in at $4.87 billion, up 18.9% year over year and ahead of the $4.75 billion consensus estimate by 2.52%.
